indications.description: Concurrent chemoradiation for stage III–IV locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma after TPF induction; confirm the source timing-anchor discrepancy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC 1.5 IV over 30 minutes on day 1 every 7 days for 7 doses, only concurrently with radiotherapy.
treatment.duration_text: 7 weekly carboplatin doses only while receiving concurrent radiotherapy; stop carboplatin if radiotherapy is truncated.
administration_notes: Calvert dose in mg = target AUC × (absolute GFR in mL/min + 25); cap GFR at 125 mL/min. Measured GFR is preferred; verify estimates in obesity or low creatinine.
250 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes. Do not continue carboplatin independently if radiotherapy is truncated.

Source p1 uses two different induction timing anchors: indication says 3–8 weeks after completion, while treatment text says day 22–56 from the start of the third induction cycle (00315/00323). Confirm the intended date with the Consultant; do not infer a start date.
